The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the nineteenth season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, [[S19|Pokémon the Series: XYZ]], in {{pmin|Australia}} and {{pmin|New Zealand}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 4}}). ==Partial collections== Two Pokémon the Series: XYZ Collections were released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in 2016 and 2017, containing the whole season between them. ===Pokémon the Series: XYZ - Collection 1=== [[File:XYZ Collection 1.png|thumb|Pokémon the Series: XYZ - Collection 1]] Pokémon the Series: XYZ - Collection 1 was released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in Australia on December 12, 2016 and in New Zealand on December 1, 2016. It contains three discs with 22 episodes across them combined.
